function.name: calculate_Bond_Price
function.description: Calculate the bond price given the face value, coupon rate, required rate of return, and maturity period. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

message.content:
抱歉，我目前無法即時查詢最新的市場數據。若您需要今天美國黃金的即時價格，建議您參考以下幾個常用來源：

| 來源 | 連結 | 特色 |
|------|------|------|
| **Kitco** | https://www.kitco.com/ | 提供全球黃金、白銀等貴金屬即時價格與歷史走勢圖。 |
| **Bloomberg** | https://www.bloomberg.com/markets | 金融新聞平台，含即時黃金價格、分析報告。 |
| **Reuters** | https://www.reuters.com/markets/commodities | 提供即時黃金價格、新聞與市場評論。 |
| **Investing.com** | https://www.investing.com/commodities/gold | 具備即時行情、技術圖表與投資工具。 |
| **Yahoo Finance** | https://finance.yahoo.com/quote/GC=F/ | 方便查看黃金期貨合約價格與相關新聞。 |

如果您想要更精確的數字（例如美元/盎司），可以直接在上述網站的搜尋欄輸入「Gold」或「Gold Futures」即可看到最新報價。若您有其他關於黃金投資或市場分析的問題，也歡迎隨時提問！
message.reasoning: User asks: "今天美國的黃金價格是多少？" They want today's gold price in US. We need to provide current gold price. We don't have real-time data. We can approximate or say we don't have real-time data. We can provide typical gold price or explain. We can also ask for clarification. Probably best to respond that I don't have real-time data.
